title: D'Andre Swift: I have no idea if the Bears will keep me, but I hope they do

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: D'Andre Swift: I have no idea if the Bears will keep me, but I hope they do
sources.description: The Bears are about $5 million over the 2026 salary cap, and they could save about $7 million in cap space by cutting running back D'Andre Swift.
